  Help  General   Commands   Custom commands

  Claude understands your codebase, makes edits with your permission, and
  executes commands — right from your terminal.
  Shortcuts
  ! for shell mode      double tap esc to clear input  ctrl + shift + _ to
  / for commands        shift + tab to auto-accept     undo
  @ for file paths      edits                          ctrl + z to suspend
  /btw for side         ctrl + o for verbose output    ctrl + v to paste
  question              ctrl + t to toggle tasks       images
                        \⏎ for newline                 alt + p to switch model
                                                       alt + o to toggle fast
                                                       mode
                                                       ctrl + s to stash
                                                       prompt
                                                       ctrl + g to edit in
                                                       $EDITOR
                                                       /keybindings to
                                                       customize

  For more help: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview

  Esc to cancel
